headline: Heard three tenant-landlord hearings; board deliberated in private without announcing outcomes
summary: The board held hearings for three cases: 58 Maple Street, 316 Flynn Ave, and 407 College Street. Parties presented evidence and testimony in each case, and each hearing was closed. The board then deliberated in private after the meeting adjourned, with no outcomes recorded.
plain_text:
BURLINGTON HOUSING BOARD OF REVIEW  
Monday, August 3, 2026 6:30 p.m.  
** REMOTE and IN PERSON**  
645 Pine Street, Front Conference Room OR  
Remotely via Zoom https://zoom.us/j/97346861647  
Minutes  
  
Board Members present: Joshua Wronski, Olivia Taylor, Emma Ramirez-Richer and Dylan Shelby 
Staff present: Kristen Kaichen 
Meeting called to order at 06:32 PM 
1. Rose Kenary and Benjamin Blanchard (tenants); Lorilee Schoenbeck (landlord) Re: 58 Maple 
Street 
 
Present were Benjamin Blanchard, Lorilee Schoenbeck and Mark Kuprych. 
Both parties presented their evidence and testimony. The hearing was closed.  
 
2. Theogesh Kiran and Yana Balich (tenants); AAM EP Burlington Owner LLC c/o Redstone 
Commercial Management (landlord) Re: 316 Flynn Ave 
 
Present were Theogesh Kiran, Yana Balich, and Glenn Von Berenwitz 
Parties were sworn in. Both parties presented their evidence and testimony. The hearing was 
closed.  
 
3. Elsenore Sheppard (Tenant); Fox Den Properties LLC (Landlord) re: 407 College Street, 
Burlington, VT 05401 
 
Present was Elsenore Sheppard. 
Elsenore Sheppard was sworn in, nobody on behalf of Fox Den Properties LLC appeared. 
Elsenore Sheppard presented her testimony. The hearing was closed.  
 
 
The meeting was adjourned at 8:33pm 
 
The Board deliberated in private.
